description: Log a retention offer interaction on a card. Builds historical dataset for retention strategy. Prefer structured fields (offer_type, offer_value_dollars/offer_points+offer_currency, outcome) over the legacy accepted boolean — they feed priority scoring and retention analytics. When the offer comes with a spend requirement (e.g., '10K MR after $5K spend in 3 months'), pass spend_requirement + spend_deadline and the server auto-creates a paired WelcomeOffer row so the spend clock appears on the calendar. The 'offer' field is a human-readable summary (RIGHT: '10K MR after $5K spend in 3 months'. WRONG: '$5000 in 3 months' — that's the spend requirement, not the bonus). Offer history is visible in get_card response. Response echoes event_id (use with delete_retention_offer or update_retention_offer).

accepted.description: Legacy — whether the offer was accepted. Prefer 'outcome' for new integrations. If both are sent, 'outcome' wins.

date.description: Date of the interaction in YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)

notes.description: Additional context — put negotiation trail, counter-offer history, retention rep notes here.

offer.description: Human-readable summary of the BONUS, not the spend requirement. Example: '10K MR after $5K spend in 3 months' (RIGHT). '$5000 in 3 months' (WRONG — that's just the spend requirement).

offer_currency.description: Program key for offer_points (e.g., 'amex_mr', 'chase_ur'). REQUIRED when offer_points is set. Omit for pure dollar offers.

offer_points.description: Points/miles amount (for points_bonus or mixed offers). Pair with offer_currency.

offer_value_dollars.description: Dollar value of the offer (for statement_credit, fee_waiver, or mixed offers)

spend_deadline.description: Deadline to meet spend_requirement in YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., '2026-07-16'). Required when spend_requirement is set.

spend_requirement.description: Required spend in dollars to earn the bonus (e.g., 5000). When set with spend_deadline on an accepted offer, server auto-creates a paired WelcomeOffer for calendar tracking.

name: log_retention_offer
